verses.text: Who is like the wise person? Who knows the meaning of things? Wisdom makes a person's face shine, and softens its hard look.
I say, "Obey the king's command," because you made a promise before God.
Do not be in a hurry to leave the king's presence. Do not stand up for something evil, for he does whatever he pleases.
For the king's word has power. Who can say to him, "What are you doing?"
Whoever obeys his command will come to no harm, and a wise heart will know the right time and the right way.
For there is a right time and a right way for everything, even though people carry a heavy load of trouble.
For no one knows what will happen. Who can tell anyone how it will happen?
No one has power to hold back the wind or the spirit, and no one has power over the day of their death. No one is let off from the battle, and wickedness will not rescue those who do it.
I saw all this when I set my mind to everything that is done under the sun. There are times when one person rules over another and hurts them.
Then I saw the wicked being buried. They used to go in and out of the holy place, and they were praised in the city where they did these things. This too is meaningless.
When a sentence against an evil act is not carried out quickly, people's hearts are filled with plans to do evil.
Even though a sinner does evil a hundred times and still lives a long time, I know for sure that it will go better with those who have respect for God and stand in awe of him.
But it will not go well with the wicked. Their days will not grow long like a shadow, because they do not respect God.

There is something meaningless that happens on earth: there are righteous people who get what the wicked deserve, and there are wicked people who get what the righteous deserve. I say this too is meaningless.

So I praise the enjoyment of life, because there is nothing better for people under the sun than to eat, drink, and be happy. This joy will go with them in their work all the days of life that God gives them under the sun.
I set my heart to know wisdom and to watch the work that is done on earth, even going without sleep day and night.

Then I saw all that God has done. No one can understand the work that is done under the sun. However hard people work to search it out, they cannot find it. Even if a wise person claims to understand it, they really cannot find it.
